title: Facial Emotion Recognition Predicts Alexithymia Using Machine Learning.
summary: Learned facial-expression features predict alexithymia scores in the studied participants; retain sample and questionnaire scope, without claiming clinical diagnostic validation. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
